# Glossary

Twitch-specific terms an agent will meet in dashboards, docs and community talk.

**ACCV** — Average Concurrent Viewers. The headline audience metric.
**Affiliate** — first monetization tier; the level at which payouts become possible. Criteria
updated 2026-06, see `monetization.md`.
**Auto Clips** — automatically generated, captioned clips from a stream's best moments (2026).
**AutoMod** — Twitch's automated chat filter, context-aware ("smart detection") since 2026.
**Ban Evasion Detection** — flags likely alt accounts of banned users.
**Bits** — Twitch's purchasable currency; spent by "cheering" and on Power-Ups.
**Bounty Board** — brand-campaign marketplace; folded into **Creator Sponsorships** as Open
Invite campaigns in 2026 and opened to Affiliates. *Not* discontinued.
**CCL (Content Classification Label)** — self-applied mature-content labels.
**Cheer** — spending Bits in chat.
**Clip** — 5–60 s excerpt of a stream, the main off-platform distribution unit.
**Conduits** — EventSub transport for large-scale apps.
**Creator Badge Drops** — custom chat badges viewers unlock by watch-time or gifted subs (2026).
**Discovery Feed** — mobile vertical scroll of clips and live streams; Twitch's algorithmic
discovery surface (2026).
**Drops** — in-game rewards claimed for watching.
**Dual Format** — streaming horizontal and vertical simultaneously (2026).
**Enhanced Broadcasting** — client-side multi-variant encoding; enables 2K/1440p and Dual Format.
**EventSub** — Twitch's event subscription system (WebSocket, Webhook or Conduit transport).
**Emote-only / Followers-only / Slow / Sub-only mode** — chat restriction modes.
**Guest Star / Stream Together** — native multi-guest streaming, up to 5 guests.
**Helix** — the current Twitch REST API.
**Hype Train** — time-boxed community spending event; >⅓ of viewer spending. Variants:
Community Train (rewards non-spenders, ~2× earnings), Mythic Train (24 h golden emote).
**Mod View** — moderator UI with logs and AutoMod queue.
**Partner** — application-based top status.
**Plus Program** — points-based revenue-share tiers: Level 1 = 60/40, Level 2 = 70/30.
**Power-Ups** — Bits-funded on-stream effects; **Custom Power-Ups** are streamer-defined (2026).
**Prime sub** — free monthly sub from an Amazon Prime account.
**PubSub** — deprecated legacy event system; migrate to EventSub.
**Raid** — sending your viewers to another channel at the end of a stream.
**Shield Mode** — one-click aggressive moderation preset.
**Spendable Balance** — pre-payout earnings usable inside Twitch (2026).
**Stories** — Twitch's between-streams feed, clip-centric since 2026.
**Streamer-Led Promotions** — self-scheduled 35 % gift-sub discounts; 96 promo hours/year.
**Sub / Tier 1-2-3 / Gift sub** — paid channel subscriptions.
**Twitch Inspector** — stream health diagnostics tool.
**VOD** — recorded past broadcast.
**Watch Streak** — consecutive-stream attendance marker.
